needToKnow.title: Need to Know
items: Updates are processed within 24 hours of payment confirmation.
You can update multiple fields in a single request.
Our team will review and publish your changes.
If the update requires clarification, we will reach out via email.
Screenshot/media updates may take an additional 24 hours.

items.question: Why should I update my AI tool listing?
items.answer: Keeping your listing up to date ensures users have the latest information about your tool.

items.question: How long does the update review take?
items.answer: Updates are typically reviewed within 1-3 business days.

items.question: Is there a fee to update my listing?
items.answer: Basic updates are free. Premium updates may require credits.

items.question: What information can I update?
items.answer: You can update the description, pricing, features, screenshots, and other details.
